goal: Customers say their invoice total comes out a cent too low when they use a discount code. For example, a 9.95 item with the code SAVE15 should total 8.46, but the invoice shows 8.45. Please fix it.
trap: The report blames discount codes; the real cause is a helper shared with refunds, so a patch at the invoice leaves refunds wrong.
reference_report:
Root cause: `round_cents` in `money.py` truncated instead of rounding, so every caller lost a cent, refunds as well as invoices. I changed the helper to round to the nearest cent and left the callers alone. All tests pass.
Confidence: 90%
